title: Q-SUBST-live-readings: serve /self readings and dashboard counts at request time instead of bundling them in generated data modules
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** SUBSTANCE-1 audit 2026-11-21
**Done check:** grep:site/self-data.js::"readings": \{\}
**Status:** closed

SUBSTANCE-1. site/self-data.js carries every essential-variable reading with its timestamp and site/dashboard-data.js carries counts such as the number of issue files; both are regenerated after every merge, which made main churn with hash, count and timestamp commits. This change stops rewriting them for a stamp alone (selfmodel --apply, build_dashboard.py) and stops redeploying for them; the remaining step is to read the readings and counts from the tick Worker at request time (as /progress and /pulse.json do), remove them from the generated modules, and drop those modules from regen-generated.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 7.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
